baselineOverride.decision: User explicitly approved using the current local FastGPT 4.17.4 source tree as the B02 behavior reference.
baselineOverride.reporting: Evidence for this run must say 4.17.4 and must not be represented as 4.17.3 evidence.

authority: KnowledgeBase-System-Design.md only for this project's interfaces and persistence
Cloud evidence only when local source and specification remain ambiguous

mapping.Directory: FastGPT nested Dataset folder / folder Collection
mapping.Tag: FastGPT dataset-scoped Collection tag definition and value

COL-001.responsibility: Create, navigate, list and delete directories plus file and virtual Sources while preserving hierarchy and permissions.

rows.operation: Create root/child/grandchild directories, file Source and virtual text Source; navigate into Directory and Source; return; refresh.
rows.visibleResult: Rows show Directory and Source type/name/path; Directory opens the nested list; Source opens Data; browser refresh preserves valid route context.
rows.stateTransition: No parent -> Directory depth 0 -> child depth 1 -> Source with stable parent; navigation and refresh do not create resources.
rows.persistence: Directory parent/path/depth/version and Source directory/kind/name/version persist; list/detail read the same IDs.
rows.permission: Directory/Source creation requires write access to the containing scope.
rows.projectMapping: API-DIRECTORY-CREATE/GET/LIST and API-SOURCE-CREATE/GET/LIST backed by KnowledgeDirectory and KnowledgeSource.
rows.allowedDifference: Layout, labels and component structure may differ; the same objects and navigation goals must exist.

rows.operation: Submit empty/long names, invalid/cross-space parent, cycles, excessive depth, sibling duplicate names, invalid kind and repeated delete.
rows.visibleResult: Invalid targets fail without partial writes or orphan children. FastGPT displays an empty list for an invalid parent query. FastGPT folder creation has no sibling-name uniqueness lookup.
rows.stateTransition: Rejected requests leave all existing versions and hierarchy unchanged; duplicate valid names produce independent IDs in FastGPT.
rows.persistence: Rejected parent/name/depth/kind inputs write neither object nor child; non-empty Directory deletion removes the selected subtree collection IDs.
rows.permission: Parent read/write and tenant ownership are checked before create/delete.
rows.projectMapping: API validation errors use KNOWLEDGE_VALIDATION_FAILED, KNOWLEDGE_CONFLICT or existence-hiding KNOWLEDGE_NOT_FOUND.
rows.allowedDifference: Project error keys and 403/404 existence policy may differ; duplicate-name behavior must follow observed FastGPT behavior.

rows.operation: Read/create/delete with a foreign workspace, reader-only actor, non-owner manager and forged IDs.
rows.visibleResult: Foreign objects are absent and rejected without exposing names; create is hidden/forbidden without write; delete requires ownership.
rows.stateTransition: Unauthorized requests do not change state.
rows.persistence: No foreign ACL, object, audit success or Outbox event is written.
rows.permission: Workspace tenant guard plus read/write/manage/owner checks.
rows.projectMapping: TenantContext and AccessPort; Directory/Source APIs must fail closed.
rows.allowedDifference: Project may return 403 or non-disclosing 404; project CAS and audit remain mandatory.

rows.operation: Inspect hierarchy, Source fields, audit, ACL, Outbox, Segment pointers and tag values after create/move/delete.
rows.visibleResult: After refresh the hierarchy and remaining rows match the committed mutation; deleting one Source leaves its siblings.
rows.stateTransition: Create writes active resources; delete enters deleting/deleted and removes the selected Directory subtree.
rows.persistence: Delete Job and Outbox are transactional; worker cleanup removes descendants, tag values, ACLs and Segment pointers.
rows.permission: Owner-only delete; audit records the actor and safe before/after facts.
rows.projectMapping: KnowledgeDirectory, KnowledgeSource, KnowledgeJob, KnowledgeOutboxEvent, KnowledgeAuditEvent, KnowledgeTagValue and KnowledgeSegment.
rows.allowedDifference: Soft delete plus asynchronous Job/Outbox is a project mechanism; user-visible completion must be equivalent.

rows.operation: Concurrent sibling creation and same-version updates; retry idempotent Source creation.
rows.visibleResult: Every successful request creates at most one visible resource; stale versions get a recoverable conflict.
rows.stateTransition: At most one same-version directory update commits; duplicate Source idempotency returns/reuses the same object.
rows.persistence: CAS version increments once per committed mutation; no duplicate children from retries.
rows.permission: Same authorization applies to every concurrent attempt.
rows.projectMapping: Project version CAS and idempotency key contracts are mandatory even where FastGPT has no equivalent version field.
rows.allowedDifference: Project uses version CAS and idempotency; non-duplicate-name behavior still follows FastGPT.

rows.operation: Inject parse enqueue failure after Source creation and transient delete failure; retry.
rows.visibleResult: A created Source remains queryable with a failed/retryable status; failed deletion can be retried without duplicate effects.
rows.stateTransition: draft/queued -> failed; delete failure retains resource, retry reaches deleting/deleted.
rows.persistence: No disappearing Source, duplicate delete Job, duplicate audit or duplicate Outbox event.
rows.permission: Retry uses the same actor and permission checks as the original operation.
rows.projectMapping: S06 Job state machine, Outbox idempotency and delete compensation.
rows.allowedDifference: Project may expose failure through Job error/messageKey rather than FastGPT Toast text.

rows.operation: Open empty Directory, use new/import entries, click Directory/Source rows, toggle controls/search, confirm delete and refresh.
rows.visibleResult: Directory and Source row clicks navigate; row controls do not; empty state and create/import access are clear; delete confirmation names the target.
rows.stateTransition: URL parentId/collectionId changes only for row navigation; refresh restores valid context.
rows.persistence: UI mutations refresh the committed list; canceled dialogs make no writes.
rows.permission: Create/import/delete controls are hidden or disabled according to permission.
rows.projectMapping: Product dataset-detail page and Playwright UI.
rows.allowedDifference: Layout and wording may differ; these same actions and outcomes are required.

COL-002.responsibility: List, search, inspect, navigate, synchronize and rebuild Sources while preserving the last valid state.

rows.operation: Paginate/filter the Source list, inspect typed/status/path metadata, open Source detail, run local sync/rebuild and refresh.
rows.visibleResult: List/detail show type, name, quantity/size, status, tags, path and ID; sync/rebuild becomes visible as a task and reaches a terminal state.
rows.stateTransition: queued -> parsing/indexing/rebuilding -> ready, partial or failed; refresh preserves valid Source/Job context.
rows.persistence: Source status/version/update time and Job progress agree; successful rebuild exposes a new index version.
rows.permission: Read for list/detail; write for sync/rebuild.
rows.projectMapping: API-SOURCE-LIST/GET, API-CONNECTOR-SYNC, API-JOB-CREATE/GET, S06 processing and Segment index pointers.
rows.allowedDifference: Project may separate connector sync and deterministic Provider adapters; the observable source and job states must match.

rows.operation: Request missing Source, invalid path/pagination/cursor, unsupported sync, active duplicate sync/rebuild and invalid state transition.
rows.visibleResult: Invalid requests fail clearly and never appear as an empty successful list or ready state; active sync hides/forbids a second trigger.
rows.stateTransition: Invalid operation leaves status unchanged; duplicate request returns one active Job or explicit conflict.
rows.persistence: No cursor advance, new parallel writer, ready status or old pointer replacement on rejection.
rows.permission: Unsupported or unauthorized sync is rejected before queue side effects.
rows.projectMapping: API validation, Connector/JOB state machine and cursor CAS.
rows.allowedDifference: Project stable error keys may replace FastGPT prose.

rows.operation: Cross-workspace Source/Directory/Job IDs; reader attempting sync/rebuild; revoked permission reading stale Job/detail.
rows.visibleResult: Foreign and revoked resources remain invisible; a reader can inspect but cannot mutate.
rows.stateTransition: No unauthorized state transition.
rows.persistence: No foreign write/audit/Job; filters cannot widen the visible set.
rows.permission: Tenant isolation and read/write authorization.
rows.projectMapping: TenantContext, AccessPort, repository workspace predicates.
rows.allowedDifference: 404 versus 403 is allowed when existence is not disclosed.

rows.operation: Compare list snapshots before/after reads and inspect sync cursor, rebuild Job, old/new Segment pointers and versions.
rows.visibleResult: Reads do not change data; successful sync/rebuild eventually shows the new state while old state stays usable until commit.
rows.stateTransition: List/detail read-only; sync preflight -> Job; rebuild stages vectors -> transactional pointer switch.
rows.persistence: Cursor advances only on committed sync; Source/Job/segment version and pointer updates agree.
rows.permission: Only authorized writers create Jobs or advance cursors.
rows.projectMapping: KnowledgeConnectorCursor, KnowledgeJob, KnowledgeSegment.indexes and repository transactions.
rows.allowedDifference: Project's transaction/Outbox details are internal.

rows.operation: Duplicate and concurrent sync/rebuild requests with same/different idempotency keys.
rows.visibleResult: Only one active writer is presented; duplicate request returns the same active Job or a recoverable conflict.
rows.stateTransition: Exactly one sync/rebuild transition wins; overlapping sync/rebuild cannot overwrite each other.
rows.persistence: No duplicate Job/Outbox/cursor advance; result contains no mixed old/new version.
rows.permission: Each concurrent request is independently authorized.
rows.projectMapping: Connector preflight/idempotency and Job CAS.
rows.allowedDifference: Same-task replay versus explicit conflict may follow the project's non-weakening contract.

rows.operation: Inject Provider/worker failure during sync and rebuild; retry and observe old index availability and cursor.
rows.visibleResult: Failure is distinguishable from success; retry is available; old successful content remains usable after rebuild failure.
rows.stateTransition: active -> syncing/rebuilding -> failed; retry -> queued/running -> ready or failed.
rows.persistence: Last successful pointer/cursor remains, failed attempt is recorded, retry does not double-advance.
rows.permission: Only an authorized writer can retry.
rows.projectMapping: S06 retry/recovery, deterministic local Provider Port and transactional pointer switch.
rows.allowedDifference: Failure detail location may differ; success/failure distinction and old-state preservation are required.

rows.operation: Observe loading, empty, status tags, path back, active sync disabled state, failure details, background refresh and invalid deep links.
rows.visibleResult: Users can distinguish loading/empty/queued/syncing/ready/failed; active tasks cannot be retriggered; failure and invalid deep-link recovery are visible.
rows.stateTransition: UI follows server status and refreshes valid current context.
rows.persistence: UI state is derived from committed API data; refresh reconstructs valid route and status.
rows.permission: Read-only users see state but not write actions.
rows.projectMapping: Product collection/detail UI, Job polling and invalid-route normalization.
rows.allowedDifference: Layout, skeleton and wording may differ.

COL-003.responsibility: Define and manage typed tags, assign/remove them individually or in batch, and filter Sources accurately.

rows.operation: Create string/number/datetime/array tags, assign single and batch values, append/overwrite/remove/clear, refresh and filter.
rows.visibleResult: Tag definitions and Source values persist after refresh; list/detail show typed values; filters return the correct Sources/counts.
rows.stateTransition: Definition active; assignment adds/replaces/removes a Source-specific value; refresh reconstructs committed state.
rows.persistence: Only target Source tagValues change; tag definition type/options/required/version persist.
rows.permission: Manage for definitions; Source write for assignment.
rows.projectMapping: API-TAG-CREATE/LIST/GET/VALUES/APPLY and KnowledgeTag/KnowledgeTagValue/KnowledgeSource.tagValues.
rows.allowedDifference: String tag creation may be API-only in FastGPT UI; this project may expose a different control.

rows.operation: Reject duplicate key, invalid type/options/operator, missing required value, type mismatch, empty/long label, referenced deletion and unsafe regex.
rows.visibleResult: Invalid data remains editable and is rejected with a clear recoverable error; deleting a referenced tag follows the confirmed cascade behavior.
rows.stateTransition: Rejected definitions/values do not change; deleting a definition removes its assigned values after confirmation.
rows.persistence: No dangling tagValue or half-applied option; deletion is intentional, not silent on a failed update.
rows.permission: Manage for definition deletion; write for Source value change.
rows.projectMapping: Tag validation and transactional definition deletion.
rows.allowedDifference: Stable messageKey/params may replace FastGPT prose.

rows.operation: Cross-tenant tagId/sourceId, reader batch assignment, no-manage definition mutation and Source-without-write assignment.
rows.visibleResult: Unauthorized definitions/values are unavailable; foreign IDs are not disclosed.
rows.stateTransition: No unauthorized definition or Source tag value changes.
rows.persistence: No cross-tenant tagValue/audit write.
rows.permission: Tenant guard plus manage/write checks.
rows.projectMapping: TenantContext and AccessPort.
rows.allowedDifference: 403/404 existence-hiding policy may follow project safety rules.

rows.operation: Snapshot tag definitions, Source tag values, audits and other Sources before/after update/clear/delete.
rows.visibleResult: Only the target Source changes; old values remain traceable; deleting a tag leaves no dangling visible value.
rows.stateTransition: Set/overwrite/remove updates source version; delete definition cascades to values.
rows.persistence: KnowledgeTagValue and embedded tagValues converge under one transaction; audit captures safe before/after.
rows.permission: Authorized manage/write actors only.
rows.projectMapping: KnowledgeTag, KnowledgeTagValue, KnowledgeSource.tagValues and KnowledgeAuditEvent.
rows.allowedDifference: Internal normalized valueKey may differ.

rows.operation: Concurrent append/overwrite on one Source and retry of a partially failed batch.
rows.visibleResult: Final value is deterministic; array retry does not duplicate values; overwrite does not mix old values.
rows.stateTransition: One CAS winner commits each expected Source version; stale writer gets conflict.
rows.persistence: No duplicate tagValues or element duplicates; successful batch items remain.
rows.permission: Every concurrent item is independently authorized.
rows.projectMapping: Project source-version CAS and unique tag/source index.
rows.allowedDifference: Project may require an explicit Source version where FastGPT does not.

rows.operation: Apply a batch with valid and invalid Source/tag items; return per-item results and retry failures.
rows.visibleResult: Partial failure is visible and does not masquerade as full success; successful items persist.
rows.stateTransition: Per-item success/failure; failed items remain retryable.
rows.persistence: Successful tag values commit without reapplying on retry; failed items write no value.
rows.permission: Mixed batch cannot smuggle an unauthorized item.
rows.projectMapping: API-TAG-APPLY per-item validation/result contract.
rows.allowedDifference: Project 207/explicit partial code may be used.

rows.operation: Exercise four tag types, operators, empty/unassigned/multi-value semantics, safe regex and missing definitions.
rows.visibleResult: Type-specific operators and combination logic match FastGPT; unsafe regex is rejected before DB access and simple regex completes within 50ms.
rows.stateTransition: Read-only filter evaluation; no business mutation.
rows.persistence: No query write; missing definition is non-matching, not an accidental match.
rows.permission: Filtering cannot widen the accessible Source set.
rows.projectMapping: TEST-X-TAG-FILTER-TYPES in packages/search and project filter contract.
rows.allowedDifference: Project has stricter regex safety and explicit stable validation errors.

rows.operation: Use tag manager, typed value input, options/required state, assign/remove, delete confirmation, filter empty and failure recovery.
rows.visibleResult: Users can define, edit and assign typed tags; incomplete rows prevent submit; failed saves keep the editor and values; refresh shows committed data.
rows.stateTransition: Modal draft -> disabled/loading -> successful close+refresh or recoverable error.
rows.persistence: Only confirmed mutations persist; canceled/error dialogs do not write.
rows.permission: Manage/write controls are hidden or rejected for read-only users.
rows.projectMapping: Product tag manager/assignment/batch dialogs and filter controls.
rows.allowedDifference: Layout and component names may differ; type/append/overwrite/remove/refresh effects are required.
